description: The three variants of a graphic the server made (close, stretch, bold) as media ids, with the one now in the edit. Draws a variant that was not drawn yet. image_id is the picture's id from edit_get.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

name: graphic_options
title: Show a graphic's three options
